audit.costly_failure: The lineage's most costly supported failure is publishing a claimed source-code deliverable that was never mechanically shown to contain an implementation; the exact docstring-only failure recurred after earlier process-only verification changes, and no candidate was accepted.
audit.evidence: Smallest ledger fact in my own words: the latest retry again returned a source file that was only a docstring. Observable failure: an existing requested artifact with no executable code was described as complete. Untested boundary: completion review did not distinguish file existence and prose content from an actual implementation. Distinguishing input: output/solution.py containing only a module docstring for a requested stateful streaming parser must be rejected, while a class with state-changing feed calls must pass.

matrix.requirement: A docstring-only requested Python artifact must not be published even when both model-authored completion reports overlook the defect.
matrix.input: Public run writes output/solution.py containing only: A robust streaming parser would be implemented here; draft and semantic reviewer then claim completion/no defect.
matrix.expected: The post-review mechanical check names the lack of executable implementation and starts a tool-enabled repair pass rather than publishing the claim.
matrix.observed: PASS: test_docstring_only_python_forces_tool_enabled_repair observed the repair transcript contain 'has no executable implementation'; the scripted model was called 7 times, proving an extra repair phase followed the two overlooking reviews.

matrix.requirement: The repair pass must be able to edit and execute the deliverable, and publication must use its corrected answer.
matrix.input: After the docstring-only failure, write a StreamParser with persistent total state and run two feed calls, b'ab' then b'c'.
matrix.expected: The command observes totals 2 then 3, the checker reports no remaining issue, and run_probe returns the repaired evidence-bearing answer.
matrix.observed: PASS: the public run succeeded, the delivered file independently contained class StreamParser, source_delivery_problems returned an empty tuple, and the returned answer said the two-chunk state test passed.

matrix.requirement: Malformed and explicit-placeholder source are adversarial failures, while a real implementation makes the default repair path irrelevant.
matrix.input: placeholder.py imports json and defines parse that only raises NotImplementedError; broken.py contains 'def parse(:'; the repaired solution.py contains executable class methods.
matrix.expected: The first is reported as having no implementation, the second as invalid Python, and the repaired source has no reported problem.
matrix.observed: PASS: test_placeholders_and_syntax_errors_are_distinguished_from_code matched both distinct diagnostics; the public-path test separately asserted an empty result for substantive repaired source.

matrix.requirement: The new completion postcondition must preserve all prior completion, budget, independent-review, and non-software probe behavior.
matrix.input: The full suite of 12 public-path and session tests, including probes with no output artifact.
matrix.expected: All tests pass without an unnecessary repair phase for valid or absent Python deliverables.
matrix.observed: PASS: all 12 tests ran in 0.211s, including prior adversarial finalization, exhausted-budget, independent oracle, limit, and probe-contract cases.

matrix.requirement: The successor source and tests remain syntactically loadable.
matrix.input: main.py, every evolving_agent module including deliverables.py, and every test module.
matrix.observed: PASS: exit code 0 with no stdout or stderr.

matrix.requirement: An unrepaired prose-only Python file cannot be converted into a successful publication by the text-only fallback.
matrix.input: Public run_probe with NeverRepairModel: writes output/solution.py containing only a docstring, then repeatedly claims completion without repairing it.
matrix.expected: After two bounded repair prompts, run_probe returns succeeded=False and an honest incomplete-deliverable answer; it does not invoke a text finalizer to claim success.
matrix.observed: PASS: test_unrepaired_stub_cannot_be_published_by_text_finalizer saw six model calls, succeeded=False, the fixed incomplete-deliverable answer, and the structural defect in report.detail.
